name: 4nemo - Genshin Fan Otome Game
source:
The story will revolve around our protagonist, Lumine, searching for the missing 4nemo member, who is also her twin brother, Aether. Aether left Lumine to attend a special school for element user (vision users in this AU) when he awakened his power. But not long before Lumine awakens her power to join the school, Aether disappears and 4nemo disbands. Now already obtaining her power and managed to join the school, Lumine tries to revive 4nemo again by impersonating Aether as well as searching for clues about Aether's disappearance.

Accompanied by the self-proclaimed best companion, Paimon, Lumine interacts with the other 3 anemo boys from 4nemo (Venti, Xiao, Kazuha) to find more clues about Aether's disappearance and solved the mystery behind it. While at it, Lumine will also living her school life making friends and join the school activities to enhance her power as well as her abilities to perform.

[From [url=https://nekokarasu.itch.io/4nemo-the-otome-game]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
故事围绕女主角荧展开——她正在四处寻找失踪的“4nemo”男团成员，也就是她的双胞胎哥哥空。当初空觉醒元素力后，便离开荧前往一所专为元素能力者（在本作架空设定中即“神之眼持有者”）设立的特殊学园就读。然而就在荧觉醒力量、即将入学前不久，空却突然离奇失踪，“4nemo”男团也随之解散。如今已获得力量并顺利入学的荧，决定女扮男装假扮成空，一边设法重组“4nemo”，一边追查哥哥失踪的线索。

在自称“最棒伙伴”的派蒙陪伴下，荧将与“4nemo”另外3名风系少年（温迪、魈、枫原万叶）展开互动，搜集更多有关空失踪一案的蛛丝马迹，解开背后的重重谜团。与此同时，荧也将体验丰富多彩的校园生活，广交好友并参加各类社团活动，不断提升自身的元素实力与舞台表现力。

[摘自[url=https://nekokarasu.itch.io/4nemo-the-otome-game]itch.io[/url]]
